tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Unbounded forcing on a ball]1. ch4:4.9,ch4:4.21,ch4:4.22\group ch04-poisson-newtonian-potential Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0074, gilbarg-trudinger:page-0075 Let $B$ be a ball, $f\in C^\alpha (B)$, and suppose for some $0<\beta <1$ that $\sup _Bd_x^{2-\beta }|f(x)|\leq N$. There is a unique $u\in C^2(B)\cap C^0(\overline B)$ satisfying $\Delta u=f$ and $u|_{\partial B}=0$, and \begin{equation} \tag {4.21} \sup _Bd_x^{-\beta }|u(x)|\leq C(\beta )N. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch For $B_R(x_0)$, the barrier $(R^2-|x-x_0|^2)^\beta $ gives

\begin{equation} \tag {4.22} |u(x)|\leq C N d_x^\beta . \end{equation}

Truncate $f$, solve the bounded-data problems, and use Corollary 14 on an exhaustion. The estimate passes to the limit and gives the boundary values; uniqueness follows from the maximum principle.

□
